name: 2D Gaussian Splatting Projection
definition: Projects 3D Gaussians into 2D image space for 2D Gaussian Splatting, computing mean, radius, depth, and ray transform matrices (M) for accumulation.
summary: 2D Gaussian Splatting Projection projects 3D Gaussians into 2D image space using ray transform matrices for efficient rasterization of elliptical splats.
